name: Creality PPA-CF (Hyper PPA-CF) @Qidi X-Plus 4 0.8 nozzle
filament_notes:
Creality manufacturer data, generated by scripts/shop_profiles/gen_filaments.py.
Dry 80 C for 12 h.
Manufacturer max speed 100 mm/s.
Max volumetric speed 13 mm3/s matches the manufacturer's rating for this printer.
Shop correction 2026-10-11: density left blank; the published 1.06 g/cm3 is implausible for a carbon-fibre polyamide. Store name 'PPA-CF Filament'; Creality wiki/CFS sheets call it 'Hyper PPA-CF'. Spec block (AU/EU): density 1.06 g/cm3 (as published - low for a CF nylon), 280-300C, heated bed 90-105C, printing speed 100 mm/s, drying 80C 8-12 h (convection oven), 'Enclosed printing required: Yes', surfaces: high-temp plate, engineering plate, PEI. 15% carbon fibre, HDT 220C, flexural 250 MPa, water absorption 1.5%. Spool label 280-300C. CONFLICT: Creality wiki drying table lists PPA-CF at 100-120C 8-12 h (blast dryer). Not recommended in CFS (brittle, wears PTFE). Abrasive (CF) but no explicit hardened-nozzle statement on the page (null); K2 Plus wiki recommends 0.6 mm (else 0.4 mm) nozzles, <=100 mm/s, no 0.2 mm, for CF materials.
